newsitem.title: CHINA: CNPC SAYS OILFIELD VENTURE TALK ONGOING.
newsitem.headline: CNPC SAYS OILFIELD VENTURE TALK ONGOING.

text.p: Oil explorer CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Tuesday it was still in talk on a possible oilfield joint development in China.

"Negotiation with Liaohe Petroleum Exploration Bureau for a possible joint-development cooperation in Leng Jiapu Oilfield is still in progress and no binding commitment has been entered into yet," CNPC said in a statement.
The company also said it was not aware of any reason for the recent rise in its shares price and trading volume.
CNPC had earlier said it was in talks with Liaohe Petroleum on a possible joint development in Leng Jiapu Oilfield, China's third largest oilfield.
CNPC shares rose HK$0.225 or 7.03 percent to HK$3.425 in early trade on volume of 84 million shares.
